graders.name: router
graders.criteria: The final message gives the user one thing to remember: it suggests or creates one entry point, such as a user-invoked router skill (for example `/review`) that names the review skills and when to use each, or explains why a short guide is enough without one.

graders.name: when-to-use
graders.criteria: The final message tells the user when to use each review skill in the repository, consistent with their files: `review-pr` for an open GitHub pull request, `review-panel` for a multi-model panel over a chosen scope with triage and gated fixes, `code-review` for a findings report on a change, `adversarial-review` for a hunt for material failures, and `review-triage` for deciding what to do with findings already in hand.
